extensionDescription.message: Sends your downloads to the Zajil download manager, to download them faster and resume them when they stop.

notRefused.message: Zajil did not take this download, so the browser went on with it.

notAnswered.message: Zajil did not answer in time. The download is paused in the browser, since Zajil may have it: look in Zajil before you resume it here.

notReachable.message: The browser cannot reach Zajil, so it went on with the download. Install Zajil, or open its settings and choose “Fix the browser integration”.

optionsExtensionsHint.message: Extensions without the dot, separated by spaces.

optionsSitesHint.message: Downloads from these sites (and their subdomains) stay in the browser. One site per line.

notAnsweredRunning.message: Zajil did not answer in time and may have taken the download, while the browser goes on with it too: look in Zajil, and cancel one of them if it is there twice.

menuRefused.message: Zajil did not take this link.

menuNotAnswered.message: Zajil did not answer in time, and may have taken the link: look in Zajil.

menuNotReachable.message: The browser cannot reach Zajil. Install Zajil, or open its settings and choose “Fix the browser integration”.

menuNotALink.message: This is not a link to a file Zajil can download.

takenAlsoInBrowser.message: Zajil took the download, but the browser had finished it too: the file is there twice, so remove one if you like.

welcomeIntro.message: Downloads of the file types you choose in the settings now go to the Zajil download manager, to download them faster and resume them when they stop. And in the right-click menu on any link: “Download with Zajil”, and on any video: “Download video with Zajil”.

cookiesTitle.message: Zajil on sites: cookies and video (optional)

cookiesWhy.message: One permission for two things. Cookies: some sites give their files only to signed-in users, and for Zajil to download those the extension reads the download link's cookies. Video: a “Download video” button over a page's videos, and noting the addresses of the video playlists (HLS and DASH) the page loads.

cookiesOnlyHere.message: The cookies go to the Zajil program on this computer, and from it to their own site only, nowhere else.

cookiesOnlyThisSite.message: For each download: only its link's site cookies, for its link only, and only when it goes to Zajil. No cookies from a private window.

cookiesNotKept.message: Zajil does not write them to disk: they stay in memory until the download finishes or is removed.

cookiesOptional.message: Without the permission the extension works as it is: files of sites that need a sign-in stay in the browser, and for videos there is “Download video with Zajil” in the right-click menu. You can take the permission back at any time in the settings.

cookiesAllowed.message: Allowed: a download link's cookies go to Zajil with its download, and the “Download video” button shows over videos.

cookiesNotAllowed.message: Not allowed: downloads go to Zajil without cookies, and videos have the right-click menu only.

signInNeedsCookies.message: This site needs a sign-in, so the browser went on with the download. For Zajil to take downloads like this, choose “Allow Zajil on sites”.

signInEvenWithCookies.message: This site refused Zajil even with the cookies, so the browser went on with the download.

menuSignInNeedsCookies.message: This site needs a sign-in. Choose “Allow Zajil on sites” for Zajil to download it, or download it with the browser.

menuSignInEvenWithCookies.message: This site refused Zajil even with the cookies. Download it with the browser.

cookiesPrompt.message: The browser will say the extension asks to “Read and change all your data on all websites” or to “Access your data for all websites”: that is what it calls this permission, as each site's cookies and videos need that site's permission. The extension reads only the download link's cookies, where the videos are and their addresses, their playlists' addresses, and the address of a link you click with Zajil's keys; never the pages' text or what you type in them.

signInNoCookies.message: This site needs a sign-in, and no cookies went (the browser gave none for this link), so the browser went on with the download.

menuSignInNoCookies.message: This site needs a sign-in, and no cookies went (the browser gave none for this link). Download it with the browser.

videoRefused.message: Zajil did not take this video.

videoNotAnswered.message: Zajil did not answer in time, and may have taken the video: look in Zajil.

videoNotWeb.message: Zajil cannot read this page: it is not an http or https page.

sitesVideo.message: Video: of a page, the extension learns only where its videos are and their addresses. Playlist addresses stay in memory, for each tab, are forgotten when it closes or opens another page, and go to Zajil only when you press. The extension watches requests and never stops or changes them, and notes nothing from a private window.

videoButtonFailed.message: The video did not reach Zajil.

sitesPartly.message: Partly allowed: a download link's cookies go to Zajil with its download, but the “Download video” button needs the rest of the permission. You can also take it all back.

keysTitle.message: Keys with a click on a link

keysBrowser.message: Leaves it to the browser (Zajil does not take its download)

keysHint.message: These work only after “Allow Zajil on sites” (below), as the extension must see the click in the page, and in open tabs once reloaded. The extension reads nothing of the page but the clicked link's address. Strict cookies (SameSite=Strict) never go with a link from another site's page, as in the browser.

sitesKeys.message: Keys with a click (in the settings): of a link clicked with Zajil's or the browser's keys, the extension learns only its address. Any other click stays the page's own.

keysUse.message: Use keys to force Zajil or keep it out

keysWarning.message: Off by default. Once on, Ctrl+click no longer opens a link in a new tab (on Windows and Linux): it sends it to Zajil, and a link that is a web page opens in a tab behind this one.
